newsitem.title: USA: Great American to offer office back rubs.
newsitem.headline: Great American to offer office back rubs.

text.p: Great American BackRub Store Inc said Wednesday it formed a new division, BackRubs-To-Go, which will offer fully clothed, seated back rubs in a corporate setting.
The company said the move comes "in response to the overwhelming calls we have been receiving for such a service."
The company said corporations are coming to realize the benefits of stress reduction in the workplace and are sponsoring programs for their employees.
